title: Octavia
summary: A short film about a city that hangs on a net, told through the rings of a fallen tree.
coverAlt: Film still of a cut tree stump with the words The net will only last so long

blocks.heading: The brief
blocks.body: Take the same city exercise into time. Under ninety seconds, no voiceover, type allowed.

blocks.heading: The city
blocks.body:
Octavia is a spider web city stretched over an abyss. Its people know the net will only last so long, and they live with that every day.

I looked for something real that holds the same tension between strength and an end date. I found it in a cut tree.

blocks.label: Storyboard. Scan of the hand-drawn frames, with timing notes.

blocks.heading: Process
blocks.body: I shot the stump in one afternoon at three focal lengths, then built the edit around a single sentence that appears a few words at a time. The type sits inside the rings, so the reading pace follows the growth of the tree.

blocks.caption: Location scouting. Replace with stills of the places you tested before choosing one.

blocks.alt: Film still with type set across the tree rings

blocks.heading: Reflection
blocks.body: The hardest decision was length. My first cut ran three times longer and said less. Cutting it down forced every shot to carry the idea.
